title: Completed06 feet/lower-leg macro construction diagnosis
mode: READ_ONLY; no modeling; no repository edits; no export or build; temporary diagnosis/crop/inventory files only

authority.distinction: GitHub main read via gh api at exact SHA is older; current eight-hour architect appendix is local and supported by parent assignment. No main synchronization claimed.
authority.scope: CG visual diagnosis only; approved stance/anchors protected; July body excluded

native.inventory_note: 566 lower-leg/foot-name-matching mesh objects; raw matrix_world/bounds/materials/flags preserved in inventory. Render visibility additionally depends on collections, so hide_render is not a pixel-visibility proof.

display_crop.operation: Display-only crop x540..1040,y510..850; resized 3x. Source untouched; adds no detail and is not a new canon.

claims.claim: The reviewed builder native matches completed06 SHA 72e7e53daf40b7128cdf9b173006c639bcf123952547a2576fb2de29130f06d4 before and after read-only Blender inventory.
claims.evidence: shasum of assets/models/cg-supervised01/attempt06/murderbird-supervised-builder.blend; turntable receipt native_sha256; Blender background load with no save command.
claims.consequence_if_false: Diagnosis could target a different model.
claims.next_check: Integrator verifies same SHA before authoring into a new native path.

claims.claim: Locked canon and candidate03 show discrete curved metal toe covers, visible stepped rims/dark joint transitions, and a banded tapered ankle-to-toe transition; First Choice 2s and 6.5s retain this general construction reading.
claims.consequence_if_false: Wrong cover language could be treated as canon.
claims.next_check: Compare frozen originals at unchanged whole-character scale and feet detail; unseen sides remain proposals.

claims.claim: Attempt06 feet detail shows swollen rounded toe sections that merge into a ribbed tube; thin repeated seam lines do not create source-like separated formed covers. Claw roots are bulbous but their tips are already pointed.
claims.consequence_if_false: A screw/texture pass could be mistaken for a construction fix.
claims.next_check: Same-camera neutral feet detail and whole image after cover-only authoring.

claims.claim: The largest demonstrated cause of soft/stylized feet is cover cross-section and joint/cuff hierarchy, rather than absence of component count. Native has five named interlocking shells and five warm seam bands per toe already.
claims.evidence: Actual feet-detail pixels plus /tmp/cg-feet-native-inventory.json (CGF03 shell/band objects).
claims.consequence_if_false: Adding more rings could repeat the same soft shape.
claims.next_check: One formed-cover/cuff checkpoint preserving anchors and outline; adjudicate actual pixels before replication.

claims.claim: The lower-leg thin impression is not established as a primary envelope failure. Current legs have visible separate rods, flanges, and central cases; source emphasizes longitudinal hard ribs plus a graduated cuff transition. Whole views also differ in pose/framing/torso coverage, so no width or length percentage is justified.
claims.consequence_if_false: Unfounded thickening could damage approved posture and silhouette.
claims.next_check: Retain segment centers/ends and evaluate cuff construction at canon-neutral, neutral-000 and neutral-090; only then consider separately scoped envelope comparison.

claims.claim: Camera and lighting affect leg/foot apparent breadth and highlight contrast, but cannot alone explain the padded cross-sections: the reading persists across neutral/workshop canon views and front/side/oblique neutral turntable views.
claims.consequence_if_false: A camera-only remedy could leave construction unchanged.
claims.next_check: Keep receipt cameras, exposure and light setup fixed for before/after.

claims.claim: The source claw has a sharper metal edge/ridge reading than current smooth bulbous roots; changing claws is deferred because a cover/cuff test can reveal how much of that difference is joint framing.
claims.consequence_if_false: A cover-only checkpoint could be overclaimed as solving all claw construction.
claims.next_check: Report residual claw-root/edge gap explicitly after test; no claw geometry change in this brief.

claims.claim: Exact hidden legacy footpads remain present as L left foot pad and L right foot pad with hide_render=true; old CG1c/CG2b toe families also remain hidden.
claims.consequence_if_false: Historical/underlying support could be deleted or unexpectedly exposed.
claims.next_check: Preserve every existing visibility flag outside the exact replacement manifest.

claims.claim: Owner likeness acceptance, engineering validity, and improvement from the proposed brief are unverified.
claims.evidence: No authoring, render, owner review, export, build, or deployment performed in this task.
claims.consequence_if_false: Diagnosis could be reported as completed artistic progress.
claims.next_check: Integrator produces new frozen same-camera checkpoint; owner artistic review remains distinct.

primary_diagnosis: Construction segmentation/cross-section is the demonstrated primary feet gap. Lower-leg envelope mismatch is not proved; replace the weak distal cuff/toe-cover language before proposing width changes.

one_authoring_brief.name: Formed distal cuff and forward-toe cover replacement within preserved envelope
one_authoring_brief.purpose: Make both planted feet read as worked mechanical parts at whole-character scale, using broad geometric rims/joint transitions rather than increased screw density.
one_authoring_brief.bounded_work: Reauthor only forward-toe visible covers/seam bands/root cuffs and distal tarsus collars 3/4/5 plus ankle ferrules. Keep centerlines, toe roots/tips, ankle/hock transforms, existing outer toe/claw/leg outline and contact heights. Start a new native from exact completed06. Preserve the 74 originals hidden only when replacement equivalents are ready; never delete.
one_authoring_brief.construction: Use existing cover envelopes as cages. Flatten each swollen dorsal crown into a gently curved formed sheet, introduce restrained side returns and a decisive stepped/rim edge, and expose a narrow recessed transition between covers. Let the cover cross-section taper along each existing toe, with visible root collar/terminal cuff framing the unchanged talon. Re-form the three distal tarsus bands and ferrule as a graduated worked cuff that visually bridges the unchanged rod/case assembly into the toe root; carve/redistribute local surface inside current bounds instead of uniformly widening or scaling the leg. Preserve polished/worn regional material graphs; construction must read before extra texture or small bolts.
